glossEn: the property resulting from being or relating to the greater in number of two parts; the main part / (elections) more than half of the votes
note: the greater number / (elections) more than half of the votes。**不可数**，用 a/the majority of。线索：a majority of students / an absolute majority。两条边界只差「选举语境」，中文统一译「多数」，合并。

glossEn: the age at which persons are considered competent to manage their own affairs
note: the age at which persons are considered competent to manage their own affairs。法律义，指「成年年龄」。现有中文无此义项，属新增。罕见。
